description: Lets the main window's bundled local UI (webtrader-shell/'s built output -- see main.rs and tauri.conf.json's frontendDist) invoke the window-control and api_request/api_request_multipart commands the window.vyxDesktop bridge wraps. No `remote` block anymore -- the window only ever loads local content now (all real network traffic goes through the api_request bridge's own reqwest::Client, not the WebView's), so there is no remote origin left to scope. The core:window:* entries below are the BUILT-IN Tauri window plugin's own commands (unused by this app's bridge) and never covered the custom commands.
